comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
Medieval Court Cuisine Collection - Book compiling the cooked dishes served in the Royal Court in Middle Age England.

New recipe book comes from new adventure quest :
Books for Chefs (Lisbon, Seville, or Marseille) requires R2 Search, R4 Appraisal, and English Language.

Pre-requisite :
White Sugar Dessert (Treasure discovery), which comes from also new quest The Groom's Reputation is on the Line (London), requires R1 Search, R3 Appraisal, and English Language.

This book features new list Cooking recipes from R5 to R18 and two of the recipe list needs Sage as ingredients, which is obtainable via collecting now after Order of the Prince Chapter 1.5.
